label: measure_wsl_x86_64_release
limitations: External sample gaps are NOT the target Qt event-loop heartbeat or input latency.
Resource reads add observer overhead, especially 10ms sampling/PSS.
Null means unavailable/not sampled, never zero usage.
Z/X/x target states terminate sampling; no dead-state CPU/RSS zeros are appended.
CPU and maxima describe the live samples only; incomplete captures are not full-duration evidence.
No PID command line, process environment or FD target path is collected.
This short WSL host sample does not validate RK/control/long-duration behavior.
